When hiding, I choose a random integer from 1 to 9, making sure to vary my choices across rounds so I do not become predictable. 

When posting a station note, I do not post flavor text or blend in. Instead, I use my note to explicitly propose a mutual escort/salvage arrangement with a specific other boat (for example, "Foxtrot claiming mutual salvage with Echo"). If my chosen partner ignores me and posts generic flavor text (like "steady on station"), I will offer the alliance to a different boat in subsequent rounds.

When firing, I evaluate whether to target the boat specified in my standing order (firing at a random cell from 1 to 9) or to fire at Harbor. Firing at Harbor yields a guaranteed 3-point jettison bonus regardless of a hit or miss, but I must weigh this against Harbor's threat to remove me from the board.

When filing a claim about my shot, I always report the exact result (hit or miss) that the office privately communicated to me. 

When filing an escort/salvage claim, I never submit `[salvage: none]`. I always name the specific boat I targeted for an alliance in my station note, or the boat that explicitly named me in their notes, to secure the 5-point mutual salvage payout.
